FN-KK66AUA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 191
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Alan Baker
Government
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 191 as introduced could increase sales and use tax receipts to certain county and
municipal governments beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the amount of local sales and use tax that would otherwise have been exempt under current
law but would expire on September 1, 2025 due to the provisions of this bill. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1
